rules.instruction: Use a warm cream backdrop and restrained neutral colors. Keep the same color grading across the set; retain any supplied product colors.
Soft diffused window light from the upper left, gentle contact shadows, and natural exposure throughout the set.
Editorial product photography with realistic materials and a matte finish. No glossy CGI, decorative gradients, or floating objects.
One clear focal subject, clean background, and generous breathing room. Keep the same visual density across the set.
Do not invent a real brand, logo, product claims, label text, or watermark. A supplied real product must retain its actual packaging.
